editionLabel: Board Game Circus German rules (2020); English summary
firstPlayerRule: Choose together who begins. The rules do not prescribe a selection method.
clarifications: This is a two-player game. After the first player takes a turn, the other player takes the next turn, and they continue alternating.
interpretation: English summary of the German Board Game Circus edition's setup instruction, 'Bestimmt, wer das Spiel beginnt.'
internalEvidence: The Board Game Circus German-edition PDF linked from its store's Downloads page was retrieved for inventory BGG identity 269257. PDF page 1 (printed page 2) and PDF page 4 (printed page 6) were rendered and visually checked. Setup step 4 says to determine who begins, without naming a method; the gameplay paragraph says players take turns one after the other. The back page credits Board Game Circus ©2020 under XV Games license. Publisher-linked Dropbox PDF SHA-256: fd5bd3b0788de2eaeaa328d3259d7b8e3b1e1f0889c6a09ad763efba1d0e058d. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The inspected German edition gives no procedure for choosing between the players or resolving disagreement. Other editions may differ.
